info-cards-grid.looks: An optional heading and intro above a grid of 1 to 4 columns of cards. Each card has an optional icon, a title, a subtitle, body text that can be a bulleted or numbered list, and up to two buttons. Cards can be dark (filled) or light.
info-cards-grid.use: The workhorse for grouping topics, services or audiences, with or without icons. The safe default when there are no images.

fields.sectionSubheading: One or two sentences under the heading.
fields.footerText: Optional small text under the grid.
fields.columns: How many cards per row: 1 to 4.

fields.title: The card heading, a few words.
fields.subtitle: Optional short line under the title.
fields.bodyContent: A paragraph, or a <ul>/<ol> list. Links inside become text links.
fields.overlayImage: A decorative background texture. Leave it empty unless asked.
